title: Turn Claude Into A Paid Social Ads Team
description:
Turn Claude into a paid social ads team.

You can connect Claude to Meta Ads data, competitor signals, brand context, creative tools , dashboards, automations, and a learning loop.

You’re building a system that can:

* analyse what’s working
* spot wasted spend
* find creative fatigue
* generate new ad angles
* create static & video concepts
* build reports and dashboards

And the best part?

The more you use it, the smarter the system gets.

Comment FUN and I’ll send the full setup guide.
